title: slicer next output is terse
findings_note: dogfooding: next prints id/title/path only — not the effective score, why it is next, or what blocks it, and there is no one-shot to start it. Consider showing score/blockers (text) and/or a --start flag.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
`slicer next` printed only id/title/path — not the effective score, why it's next, or its
status, and there was no one-shot to start it. Filed dogfooding.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- src/slicer/cli.py: `cmd_next` shows score/status; new `--start` flag.
- tests/test_next.py; README.md, docs/agents.md.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
Show the returned item's effective score (with `^` when inherited from a dependent, via
graph.effective_scores) and status; add `effective_score` to `--json`. Add `slicer next --start`
to mark the returned item started in one command, taking the project lock only when it mutates
(reusing ops.start). `next` stays read-only by default.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
`slicer next` shows a `score N · status` line; `--json` carries effective_score; an inherited
score shows `^`; `next --start` starts the item (idempotent) and does nothing when none is
eligible. Focused next tests, the unit suite, slicer check, and git diff --check.
